paragraphs: Rava bar Natan, to Rav Huna. Rabbah bar Natan asked Rav Huna: Bava Kamma 32a. He asked R' Yohanan: Bava Batra 176a. Also R' Hiyya bar Abba, R' Assi, and Rav Nahman: Eruvin 32b. See R' Abba bar Natan; perhaps they are one. Rav Hama, Rav Yosef's father, asked him.
